prompt: Develop this original travel note into an engaging paragraph without adding landmarks: 'A ferry crossing at dawn. Grey water. Warm bread in a paper bag. A child counting buoys. The far shore becomes distinct very slowly.' Aim for about 80 words.
text: At dawn, the ferry moved steadily across grey water, its low hum blending with the quiet of the deck. I held warm bread in a paper bag, letting the heat reach my hands through the thin paper. Nearby, a child counted the buoys as they slipped past, starting over whenever the rhythm broke. Ahead, the far shore appeared almost reluctantly, its outline sharpening so slowly that it felt less like arrival than waking.
